details:
I play VRC on PC with quest 2 by use Visual Desktop

When I join meet people the problem will start when someone switch to another avatar (it doesnt matter avatar is very poor or not, it happened to everyone) their avatar will become Error robot

I asked them to try change another one and back to this, but it is still robot. I notice their nameplate show message "Security Check Failed" I dunno why

- This problem happen only my view, people can see their own avatar meanwhile I see them as robot

- To be robot, as I noticed it happen for people's upload avatar and public avatar

- To solve this problem I have to restart VRC to see their avatar again but the problem still keep happen if they switch again

- My shield level is Normal

-  Once they use avatar that I see them as robot, it wont change even switch to another one

-------------------------

So what I tried and did is:

- Update my avatar by use latest version of sdk

- Reinstall VRC and clean everything

- Cleared all caches

- Updated all drivers latest version (including vrc and windows)

- Restart my route network
title: Error Robot Avatar random
